task: O05 smoke absorption cache prototype and evidence
status: opt-in prototype implemented; disabled allocation fix and three-scale sustained comparison complete; no total GPU render win found; temporal and portability acceptance remain open

comparison.candidate: smoke_absorption_cache enabled; primary authored fire light only
comparison.image_difference: absolute RGB error against direct capture; 0..255 channels

limitations: Three short paired route samples are directional evidence, not sustained acceptance.
The cache pass adds GPU work and total GPU render medians were slightly slower in these runs; no speedup claim.
One fixed still at one camera/tick does not quantify temporal error or establish moving-ember/light quality.
Windows DX12 and other GPU backends remain unverified.
Cache currently handles only the primary authored fire light; particle lights and fallback points use direct sampling.
Longer motion, rapid density/light edit, paused-edit, native-window, Windows DX12 and other GPU acceptance remain open.

disabled_path_followup.change: Allocate the 3D absorption cache only while enabled. Disabled shading binds an existing smoke volume as an unused fallback texture, does not dispatch the build pass, and reports zero cache bytes and zero cache CPU encode time. Live toggles rebuild the dependent volume and optical bind groups transactionally at the next render.
disabled_path_followup.protocol: Metal serve session, seed 42, tick 300; start disabled, toggle enabled, toggle disabled; inspect_effects/get_metrics and capture at each state
disabled_path_followup.gpu_verify: python3 scripts/verify.py --gpu passed; Metal; native false

size_scale_followup.fire_state_parity: exact at tick 300 for all direct, 8^3 and 16^3 variants
size_scale_followup.interpretation: The targeted atmosphere_fire GPU stage improved by 0.058-0.101 ms, but the cache adds a separate 0.025-0.033 ms GPU build stage and the measured total gpu_render median was slower in all six comparisons (+0.025 to +0.044 ms). frame_work medians favored the cache but are not matched by total GPU time and include unrelated variance. No useful total-render cost range is demonstrated; keep disabled by default.
size_scale_followup.visual_review: Inspected matched tick-300 contact sheet at all three scales; 16^3 is closer to direct by per-channel mean absolute RGB error at every scale. Continuous temporal review and edit-invalidation stress are not included.
size_scale_followup.verification: Capture parity and six sustained profile_compare runs passed; macOS Metal only, native window false.

invalidation_followup.fire_state_parity: exact at all 13 direct/cache checkpoints for both cache resolutions
operations: paused density edit followed by fixed tick
moving ember lights at four deterministic ticks
invalidation_followup.interpretation: No stale-cache discrepancy or discontinuous failure was observed in the discrete captures. 16^3 remained closer to direct than 8^3. This is freshness evidence, not continuous temporal acceptance.
limitations: Headless Metal serve only; native window and other GPUs unverified.
Continuous temporal pixel error and wall-clock resume timing were not measured.
